description: Imports an image file (PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, WebP…) as a new pixel layer. The pixels are stored as-is; the placement only sets the layer's transform.

above.description: Place directly above this layer (id or name)

below.description: Place directly below this layer (id or name)

name.description: Layer name (defaults to the file name)

origin.description: Explicit top-left position in canvas pixels; overrides centering

parent.description: Folder (id or name) to put the layer in; omit for the root

path.description: Path to the .comp project package (a directory ending in .comp)

placement.description: original: 1:1 pixels centered; fit: scale to fit inside the canvas; fill: scale to cover the canvas; stretch: match canvas size

size.description: Explicit display size in canvas pixels; overrides placement

name: add_image_layer
title: Add image layer
